notes.title: v1.0.3 Build Live
notes.content:
We've released a new patch which is primarily focused on enemy AI improvements.

[list][*] Each boss received a new ability. These are similar to player heavy attacks so be careful to try to avoid them.
[*] Improved the enemy attack randomization system.
[*] Damaging an enemy mid-attack will now have a chance to reset their combination order.
[*] Several enemy types now have leaping abilities. These can knock you down but you can also catch them mid-air to counterattack.[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch
notes.content:
We released a minor patch today to address an issue with gamepad and keyboard navigation in the main menu. 

This issue could happen if there were no saved games games and would consume the first input through the hidden load menu item forcing you to double tap the input key.  

This issue has been resolved.

notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch Is Live
notes.content:
We have a small patch based on player feedback from the first day of Early Access. 

[*] Added two new achievements, one for playing in Tournament Mode and the other for playing in Beat mode. 
[*] Added new Rotate Left and Rotate Right keybindings. 
[*] Playing on Beginner difficulty mode can now scale the maximum health of targets down it was previously capped to the health level of normal difficulty.

notes.title: Beatdown Brawler Control and Game Mode Details
notes.content:
With Beatdown Brawler about 40 days from release we've added details on the games Controls and Game Modes to the discussion forums and are duplicating them here to get some additional information out to the public and to beta testers.

[h1][b]Controls[/b][/h1]

[b]Attack[/b] - Left Mouse / E / Gamepad A
[b]Avoid/Dash[/b] - Left Shift / Gamepad Left Shoulder
[b]Block[/b] - Middle Mouse / F  / Gamepad Left Trigger
[b]Kick[/b] - Right Mouse / Q / Gamepad X (Left Button)
[b]Grapple[/b] - C or Special + Heavy
[b]Focus on Target[/b] - T
[b]Roll[/b] - Space / Gamepad Y
[b]Jump[/b] - Roll (Space / Gamepad Y) + Special
[b]Select Target[/b] - R - / Gamepad B
[b]Toggle Special[/b] - X - Gamepad Right Shoulder
[b]Toggle Heavy[/b] - Z - Gamepad Right Shoulder
[b]Special Ability 1[/b] - 1 or Special + Punch
[b]Special Abilility 2[/b] - 2 or Special + Kick
[b]Rotate Camera[/b] - Mouse / Gamepad Right Thumbstick
[b]Movement[/b] - W,A,S,D / Gamepad Left Thumbstick
[b]Pause[/b] - Escape / Gamepad Special Right
[b]Hide UI[/b] - Alt-U

[h2][b]Additional Control Related  Notes[/b][/h2]

[*] Heavy Attacks are directional. Meaning moving upwards while performing one will perform an upwards or jumping attack, and moving downwards while performing them will attempt a leg or crouching attack. 
[*] Some attacks only open up based on a combination being performed. It is possible to chain some combinations through complex series of loops.
[*] Certain moves will not be available during rhythm mode. In general any move that would warp time or require multiple attacks is disabled if you are playing in the optional rhythm based mode.

[h1][b]Game Modes[/b][/h1]

[b]Traditional[/b] - This is default game mode. Your objective is to survive waves of enemies and then defeat the boss. The level will end when the boss is defeated.
[b]Survival[/b] - You will play on a single level with a never ending supply of enemies and periodic bosses. Spawns will come more quickly, and enemies will scale in difficulty over time. Your goal is to survive as long as possible.
[b]Rhythm[/b] - In Rhythm mode your goal on each level is to survive until the song ends, while also defeating a quota of enemies and a boss who will spawn later during the song. Performing attacks, dodges, blocks, on beat will reward Chi and do full damage, while using actions off beat will reduce Chi and do partial damage. Hit lands are timed to occur on beat and heavy attacks are disabled.
